title: The Atlas of the Palatinate
author: Oscar Lockridge
blurb: Felix Dravenmoor, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
